note: v0.23.0：熊猫品牌图标定案 + 诺诺功能导览 + 视图问候补齐 + 一个真缺陷修复。① 品牌图标（康哥拍板「以熊猫作为品牌图标（header 红色标识 + favicon）」）：header 唯一品牌图标位 icons/logo-header.png 换成 squircle 朱砂红渐变底（#c2362b→#87211a）+ 描金细边 + 熊猫头特写；favicon-32.png 同源 LANCZOS 缩出。改前 header 图上朱砂红像素仅 2.05%、favicon 0.00%（纯白熊猫在浅色浏览器标签栏上等于隐形），改后 47.5% / 50.5%；且 header 图 10,912 B → 9,668 B（FASTOCTREE 量化保住透明圆角，体积反而更小）。验收口径是「缩到 34px 真实渲染仍可辨五官」，不是 192² 上好看；引用路径未变，SW 预缓存清单无需改动。② 新增「诺诺带你认识产品」6 站导览（面板模式菜单 Tour + 首页浮动邀请）：首页→练习→字卡→声调→城市→进度，每站绑一个汉字 + 拼音 + 英文释义（今天只要一句 / 跟我念 / 听一听，说一说 / 慢慢来 / 你去哪儿 / 你做到了）—— Edify Gate 在 IP 层的转译：导览的每一站都必须换来一句中文；入口按位阶铁律藏进二级位置，不占主路径。③ 视图问候覆盖 13/17 → 16/17：补 sentences / reading / prog 三个视图；并把既有的「New here? 60 SECONDS」首启引导卡接上诺诺。④ 修一个真缺陷：诺诺浮标被 Feedback 按钮物理压住（#nono-dock 与 #fb-open 同占右下角 right:12px，fb-open 在 DOM 靠后、同 z-index 60）；根因是 fb-open 的默认位置「CSS 写左下、JS 默认值也写左下，但 applyDefault() 从未在初始化时调用」，首次访问者从没落过左下 —— 修后首次访问者的 Feedback 按钮落到左下，诺诺浮标独占右下，两者矩形实测不相交。⑤ 语言包 6 语言各 +6 key（导览骨架按钮），574 → 580 key，仍零英文 fallback。静态验收 28 项 / 导览真跑 40 项 / 既有烟测 31 项全绿。网页版 v0.23.0。
noteEn: v0.23.0: panda brand icon, a guided tour, wider companion coverage, and one real defect fixed. (1) Brand icon: the header logo and favicon are now a squircle tile with a cinnabar-red gradient (#c2362b to #87211a), a thin gold rim and a close-up panda head. Before this, the header mark held only 2.05% cinnabar pixels and the favicon 0.00% - a white panda is effectively invisible on a light browser tab strip. Now 47.5% and 50.5%, and the header PNG actually shrank from 10,912 to 9,668 bytes. The acceptance test is whether it still reads at the real 34px render size, not how it looks at 192px. (2) A six-stop guided tour (Tour in the companion menu, plus an invite on the home screen): home, practice, character cards, tones, cities, progress - each stop binds one Chinese phrase with pinyin and an English gloss, so every appearance of the companion still buys one more Chinese sentence. (3) Contextual greetings now cover 16 of 17 views, up from 13. (4) Fixed a real defect where the companion button sat underneath the Feedback button - both anchored to the same bottom-right corner; a new visitor's Feedback button now lands bottom-left instead. (5) Six new UI keys across all six languages - 580 keys, still zero English fallback.

v0.18.0 Audit sweep: raw escape text on screen, horizontal scrolling on Review, Nono bubbles lingering across pages, and internal badge IDs leaking. (1) The Review heading used to render as literal "\u{1F501} Smart review" because the escape was written in static HTML and never decoded. (2) Review cards could be dragged sideways - a 298px-wide stretched button blew past the viewport by 115px; the whole app now has zero horizontal overflow. (3) Nono no longer keeps a previous page's bubble on screen (you could be reading the 30-day plan while the bubble talked about flashcards). (4) Badge unlocks used to show internal IDs such as streak3 / first_city; they now show badge names. (5) 149 Chinese-UI strings added - no more English fallback in the 30-day titles and notes, the 18 city blurbs, badge names, review actions, dialogue categories and tone names. (6) Primary tap targets raised to 44px and the 30-day notes go to two lines instead of truncating mid-sentence. (7) Compliance: the Hong Kong city card is now labelled Hong Kong, China.
